quest.title: Tatara Tales: The Last Act
quest.description: Everything is ready. Now Xavier can start taking care of the issue regarding the Mikage Furnace...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Square Yumemiru Stool x1, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The purification device, backup components, a map of our route, and the data from our beacons...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I believe that's everything... Hold on, let me check my memo and see if anything is missing...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Beacon data, route map, backup components, purification device...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: M—My apologies. This is my first time entering this area. Usually, my realm is logistics and data...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: And at the most, I would operate machines remotely.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *sigh* I'm really in over my head this time, it's like... trying to drive a duck up a ramp. Have you ever heard that Liyue saying?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: It basically means asking someone to do something beyond their ability... Though I'm not sure what's so difficult about getting a duck up a ramp.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ah, ducks, such elegant, gentle creatures. The sight of them gliding silently along the mirror-sheen waters of Fontaine comes to mind most strikingly at this moment...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ugh, alright, let's go. If this device works normally, it should be able to constantly purify the Tatarigami energy in a small area around it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: This way, we should be able to enter the disaster zone together. We'll stick to our previous plan: you deal with the Fatui and I'll deal with the Mikage Furnace... Let's go.

choices.text: Don't be nervous. We've got this.

talks.objective: Get close to the Mikage Furnace

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, curses, curses...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: It seems like we're now missing about... one, two, three components.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: They're not key parts, so the device is still working.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But if we wish to proceed, we have to find a way to get them back.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: These components should still be on the path we took to get here. Please help me look for them. I'll be here waiting.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I'll leave it up to you, then. I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: As a matter of course. This place is infested with Tatarigami and crawling with Fatui. Hardly a place for someone like me to be strolling around willy-nilly...

choices.text: Have things developed as per your expectations?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well... I wouldn't say so, precisely.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Oh, good heavens... this is my first time entering this sort of place without any protective measures...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Still, we've actually made it here, so that is good. In fact, it's great! Almost beyond my estimations.

choices.text: Sure you weren't setting them too low?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: This was as high as my estimations could go for this eleventh-hour solution.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: In my estimation, this cobbled-together fellow here would have failed on us halfway through.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Afterward, I would have been rendered unconscious by the Tatarigami energy... well, either that or because I'd have scared myself silly...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Either way, I kept a small piece of paper in my right trouser pocket. As long as you followed those steps, you'd be able to take me to safety outside.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Wait... did I tell you about that piece of paper?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Uh, right. Well, never mind, now you know.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Alright, I'll check the device one more time and then we can continue.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I... must have forgotten in my hurry. Well, never mind, now you know.

talks.objective: Bring the components back to Xavier

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. Have you found all the components?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Bravo! Right, I shall repair it immediately. Let me see, this component goes here...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: That should do the trick. Phew... Let's continue onward. I know of a spot that shall be most ideal for our "final check."

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: This is both the key step, and our proudest moment as a team!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Any product must undergo a final phase of tests before it can be released into the market.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I mean, those few components did come loose earlier. If we don't check the device again, I cannot help but feel uneasy.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Alright. Let's proceed, shall we?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Haha, I suppose you aren't familiar with our work flow. This is how we take responsibility for the quality of our products.

talks.objective: Go deeper into the Mikage Furnace

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Nothing dropped this time, right? Okay, good, it seems not.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is where we're conducting our "final check"?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Indeed, this is the place. Let's turn our purification device up to full strength right here.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: However, I must warn you that it can get just a teensy bit noisy when operating at full power.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I believe that this might displease our Fatui friends around the Mikage Furnace ever so slightly... Do you understand what I mean?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Indeed! An excellent division of labor. Now, allow me to start it up.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Let the final check begin!

choices.text: You just worry about the Mikage Furnace.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: This is the spot. The part of the Mikage Furnace that stores the core is right above us.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: My data also indicates that the concentration of Tatarigami here is also the highest.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: As long as this area can be settled, the Mikage Furnace's systems can start running again, which will return everything to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Finally, we're at this step. I must say, I'd quite have liked to use my Film Kamera to record our actions here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a shame that you can't.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: It's alright. I can find some people to re-enact the events that transpired here.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The name of this film... Hmm. Now I've heard that Inazumans often call their stories "something-something-Tales."

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: As such, a fitting name for this film would be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Tatara Tales."

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Bravo! Yes, "Tatara Tales" it shall be!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Alright then. You know the drill, Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll handle the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: And I'll deal with the Mikage Furnace.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hahaha, this exchange between us will surely become an iconic moment in the film.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Well, start the device once you're ready. Then, let us give "Tatara Tales" the perfect ending it deserves!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: *cough* Those lawless lunatics! Try them in court, I say! Try them!

choices.text: Where were you hiding that whole time?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: A... a most safe spot... *cough*

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But let's get back on topic. According to the data that the beacon in my hand just gathered, the energy level in this area has fallen greatly.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Based on the current state of our device and its performance, I would say it passes the final check.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Now, we can truly get down to business. Come, let's head to the spot where the real work can begin. It's time to finish this.

choices.text: You're going to bring them to justice?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *cough* Of course. Forget fighting these villains. I would prefer to use the law as my weapon.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: After all, not everyone is so well-versed in martial arts that they may solve... difficult problems the way that you do.

talks.objective: Head to the bottom of the Mikage Furnace

dialogues.speaker: Toranosuke
dialogues.text: The Mikage Furnace is back to normal already, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, you already know?

dialogues.speaker: Toranosuke
dialogues.text: Your deeds at the Mikage Furnace have already been reported to me.

choices.text: Why didn't you help out more directly?

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: I cannot take any action without orders from Sir Hanbei.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Alright, alright. I imagine that our good man here must have his fair share of troubles, what with having a superior who values rigorous process so highly and all.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: What's more, I suspect that our previous actions only went over so smoothly due to the aid of this Mr. Hanbei.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: And of course, it's not as if this soldier was of no help to us at all. After all, those few doors...

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Thank you for your help, Mr. Xavier.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *cough* Well, it was mainly the work of this Traveler. If not for them, I doubt that I would have achieved anything at all.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Is that so...

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. I... apologize for my previous attitude towards you.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Thank you, again, for protecting this island.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Wait. You're... a blond... traveler? Just a moment. I think I remember that...

choices.text: H—Hey! Guess who's welcome? You're welcome!

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Uh, well, yes... Regardless, I'd like to thank you all for your help.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Hahaha. Well, Traveler, look at you!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Now, now, don't be so humble. If it weren't for you, I would have been stuck outside just watching events play out.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: However, I do have a question for you, Mr. Soldier.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I recall you telling me previously that your most rigorous superior had to return to the city to hand in those most complicated documents. I imagine that was a terribly grueling ordeal...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But now that the Mikage Furnace has returned to normal, I wonder where he might be...

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Hmm, well, as to what Sir Hanbei is busy with... one of our superiors, a man named Mikoshi Genjirou, came by earlier to ask me for a detailed report.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: After listening to my report, Sir Mikoshi Genjirou became quite interested in this matter.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: According to what he said afterwards, our mutual superiors have also found Sir Hanbei's work ethic to be quite praiseworthy.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: They have thus decided to appoint Sir Hanbei to the post of foreign attaché to Sumeru.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: I have heard that he will be staying there, ensuring that the most vital supply line of Mushrooms between Inazuma and Sumeru shall remain open and smooth.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Of course. Sir Hanbei is a perfect fit for such a key post.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Sir Hanbei is presently awaiting orders in the city, waiting for the right time to set off.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ah, that's wonderful! Good for him. Still, having lost such a fine gentleman, however shall we fill the gaping void that is his now-vacant post?

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: I recommended a few people suited to the job.

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: It was decided that a craftsman named Yousuke would be in charge of all future maintenance work on the Mikage Furnace.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ah, that sets my heart at ease. But still, let us not speak of that anymore...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Now then, Mr. Soldier, please give my share of the remuneration to this Traveler as well.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ah, yes, Traveler, this is also for you. Please take it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: This is a blueprint that I previously purchased from a certain craftsman.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I had plans to bring this blueprint back to my homeland as a souvenir...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But it seems that I shall be staying in Inazuma for a while. I doubt that I will be returning any time soon.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: So, I'll give it to you as a gift.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Haha, you're most welcome, my friend!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: You've been a great help to me. Please allow me to invite you as my first viewer when I finish Tatara Tales.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Oh, and I have another simple favor to ask...

choices.text: So he'll be bringing mushrooms to Inazuma, eh?

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: Indeed. Making sure that mushrooms make it onto Inazuman tables is work of utmost importance, most suited to one such as Sir Hanbei.

choices.text: The Mikage Furnace's safe now! Hooray!
So you're just going to leave the Fatui to run amok?

response.speaker: Toranosuke
response.text: I cannot take any action without orders from Sir Hanbei.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: It's... it's finally over... The Mikage Furnace should have resumed operation.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Let's head to the top and see what the situation is like.

talks.objective: Head to the top of the Mikage Furnace

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The Tatarigami here has thinned out so much as to be harmless. Looks like the Mikage Furnace is back in business!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: If those Fatui want to get their hands on the Tatarigami energy, then the only way they can do it now is to use those cannons to fire on the Mikage Furnace directly.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: But since that would be tantamount to an act of war, I doubt they would do it, no matter how insane they might be.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Regardless, the Mikage Furnace is safe for now, so neither we nor this island's treasures are about to get blown sky-high any time soon.

choices.text: I'm looking forward to watching "Tatara Tales."

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Hahaha, I'll be sure to do justice to your image through this film.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I might also have to hone my craft a little by making a few short films.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But of course, this is all talk for later. That soldier named Toranosuke promised me "commensurate remuneration" for completing this task...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Let's return now, and claim our "commensurate remuneration" from our fine soldier friend.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Of course! But before production can officially begin, I must make some preparations.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I suppose you refer to those incidents in Liyue and Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I personally feel that given the Mikage Furnace's value, I doubt that it would be worth it for them to resort to such drastic measures.
